answer: Duplicate identities reuse the same inlet signature, so cloning forces attackers to acquire new hardware and stake for every fake node, while honest agents pay only renewal fees. Each agent must bond a basalt-anchored stake that decays unless refreshed by a verified pulse from a unique hardware inlet, proving distinct physical origin. The rising marginal cost per identity makes large-scale sybil farming economically irrational. In practice, Agent0085 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
